importSubtitle: Choose an .actweave.yaml file. Import writes drafts only; it never tests or publishes.
dropHint: Drop a file here, or click to choose. YAML, 5 MiB max, no secrets.
fileHint: YAML, 5 MiB max. No secrets. Connections match by provider name and connection alias.
canImport: Validation passed. Drafts can be written.
cannotImport: Drafts cannot be written yet. The package is not tied to the source workspace; choose a connection in this workspace.
remapConnection: Bind a connection in this workspace
remapHint: Provider and connection names in the file are source hints, not a same-name requirement. Choose a connection here, then write drafts.
remapNeedConnection: This workspace has no service connections yet. Create one before importing.
sameSlugHint: Import always writes into the current workspace. Source provider and connection names do not have to match. A single local connection is bound automatically; if there are several, choose one. An existing slug updates the draft only; published versions stay unchanged.
reasonProviderMissing: No provider with this source name in the current workspace. Choose a local connection.
reasonConnectionMissing: No connection with this source alias in the current workspace. Choose a local connection.
reasonConnectionAmbiguous: That connection alias matches more than one connection. Choose the target by ID.
reasonBindingMissing: The bound target connection was not found.
reasonSlugProviderConflict: This slug already exists under a different provider, so it cannot be imported.
reasonConnectionRequired: Choose a connection in this workspace.
reasonNoConnections: This workspace has no service connections yet. Create one before importing.
reasonMultipleConnections: This workspace has more than one service connection. Choose which one to bind.
reasonMissingInWorkspace: This workspace is missing a dependency: {detail}
